title: The Kettle Filled before the Ask
youtube_title: The Kettle Filled before the Ask | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Helping without being asked is a quiet sort of brave.
summary: At a harbor step where parcels change hands, a kettle that was empty just before tea is awkward for one person. Tala notices Papa struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
